summary.headline: Planetary Judgments of Character
summary.text: Astrological judgments about a native’s character and reputation from planetary house placements and aspects, including Jupiter, Mars, the Sun, Venus, the Moon, and Mercury, with further emphasis on the ninth sign and common signs.
